title: Infinite loop in background worker consuming 100% CPU
symptoms: All 8 CPU cores at 100% utilization. System load average: 32. Response times > 30s for all requests. Logs: WARNING CPU throttling detected. Process list showing Python worker consuming 99.8% CPU. New requests timing out immediately.
root_cause: A while loop in the email retry worker had a bug where the break condition was never reached when the email service returned a specific error code (429 Too Many Requests). The worker was retrying in a tight loop with no backoff, consuming all CPU resources.
fix_applied: 1. Killed runaway process: kill -9 <pid>. 2. Fixed retry logic to use exponential backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, max 60s. 3. Added max retry count of 10. 4. Implemented CPU usage alert at 90% per process. 5. Added circuit breaker for external email service calls.
